+        # (same as re.findall(self.compiled_pattern, text), without the
+        # per-call pattern lookup of the module-level function)
+        text_chunks = self.compiled_pattern.findall(text)
+        # all chunks of text are encoded separately, then results are joined.
+        # chunks repeat a lot in natural text (" the", ","): encode each distinct
+        # chunk not yet cached once (cache: chunk -> ids, shared by the caller);
+        # chunks encode independently, so the encoding order does not matter
+        encode_chunk = self._encode_chunk
+        for chunk in set(text_chunks).difference(cache):
+            cache[chunk] = encode_chunk(chunk.encode("utf-8"), inf)
+        # then join the cached ids of all chunks in order (in C)
+        return list(chain.from_iterable(map(cache.__getitem__, text_chunks)))
